calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  COALESCE(s.region, 'Web') AS region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(s.region, 'Web')
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, region

SELECT DISTINCT region, COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  CASE 
    WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web'
    WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
    WHEN s.region IS NULL THEN 'Other'
    ELSE s.region 
  END as reporting_region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, reporting_region
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, reporting_region

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN s.region END) as region_fy2025,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN s.region END) as region_fy2024,
  MIN(s.open_date) as open_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN s.region END) = 'Capital Region'
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN s.region END) IS NULL
ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT 
  COALESCE(fy_2025.region, fy_2024.region) as region,
  ROUND(COALESCE(fy_2025.net_sales, 0), 2) as net_sales_fy2025,
  ROUND(COALESCE(fy_2024.net_sales, 0), 2) as net_sales_fy2024,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(fy_2024.net_sales, 0) > 0 
    THEN ROUND(((COALESCE(fy_2025.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(fy_2024.net_sales, 0)) / COALESCE(fy_2024.net_sales, 0) * 100), 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END as growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region IS NULL THEN 'Unclassified'
      ELSE s.region 
    END as region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  GROUP BY region
) fy_2025
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region IS NULL THEN 'Unclassified'
      ELSE s.region 
    END as region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  GROUP BY region
) fy_2024
ON fy_2025.region = fy_2024.region
ORDER BY CASE 
  WHEN COALESCE(fy_2025.region, fy_2024.region) = 'Web' THEN 0
  WHEN COALESCE(fy_2025.region, fy_2024.region) = 'Unclassified' THEN 99
  WHEN COALESCE(fy_2025.region, fy_2024.region) = 'Head office' THEN 98
  ELSE 1
  END,
  COALESCE(fy_2025.region, fy_2024.region)
